name: Ariyalur
summary: Limestone and fossil rich region, home to Rajendra Chola's imperial capital Gangaikonda Cholapuram.

profile.Crafts: Limestone cement, Cashew processing

points: Houses Gangaikonda Cholapuram UNESCO World Heritage Chola temple built in 1035 CE
Famous for Mesozoic marine fossil beds

name: Chengalpattu
summary: Coastal historic district boasting Mamallapuram UNESCO rock monuments and tech SEZs.

profile.Crafts: Granite stone sculptures of Mamallapuram

points: 7th-century Pallava dynasty shore temples and rock-cut rathas at Mahabalipuram
Automotive manufacturing corridor of Chennai

name: Chennai
summary: Gateway to South India, historic capital featuring Fort St. George, Marina Beach, and Carnatic music.

profile.Food: Idli Sambhar, Filter Coffee, Murukku Sandwich
profile.Crafts: Bronze idols, Leather goods

points: Marina Beach is the second-longest urban natural beach in the world (13 km)
Kapaleeshwarar Temple in Mylapore represents classical 7th-century Dravidian Shaivism

name: Coimbatore
summary: The Manchester of South India, engineering capital on the Noyyal river renowned for textiles and pumps.

profile.Food: Kovai Biryani, Pallipalayam chicken, Annapoorna Sambar
profile.Crafts: Wet grinders, Cotton yarn, Precision engineering

points: Major manufacturing center producing 50% of India's water pumps and motors
Home to Marudhamalai Murugan temple and Adiyogi Shiva bust

name: Cuddalore
summary: Coastal maritime district famed for Silver Beach, Chidambaram Nataraja Temple, and Neyveli lignite.

profile.Crafts: Cashew nut processing, Ceramic pottery of Panruti

points: Nataraja Temple at Chidambaram is the center of the cosmos in Hindu cosmic dance philosophy
Neyveli Lignite Corporation operates major open-cast mines and thermal plants

name: Dharmapuri
summary: Agricultural territory along the Kaveri river celebrated for Hogenakkal Falls and mango orchards.

profile.Crafts: Sericulture, Bamboo basketry

points: Hogenakkal Falls known as the 'Niagara of India' features carbonatite rocks
One of the leading mango and sericulture producers in Tamil Nadu

name: Dindigul
summary: Fortress city celebrated for GI-tagged handcrafted brass locks, Dindigul Thalappakatti biryani, and Kodaikanal.

profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Dindigul handmade iron/brass locks

points: Dindigul Rock Fort constructed in the 17th century by Nayakas of Madurai
Includes hill station Kodaikanal ('Princess of Hill Stations') in Palani Hills

name: Erode
summary: The Turmeric City (Manjal Maanagaram), premier textile market and Bhavanisagar dam region on the Bhavani River.

profile.Food: Kongu Nadu mutton chukka, Ragi kali
profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Erode Turmeric, Bhavani Jamakkalam carpets

points: Major turmeric trading terminal in India with GI certification for Erode turmeric
Birthplace of rationalist social reformer Periyar E. V. Ramasamy and mathematician Ramanujan

name: Kanchipuram
summary: The City of Thousand Temples and Silk, ancient capital of the Pallava dynasty and center of Vedantic philosophy.

profile.Food: Kanchipuram Idli (spiced steamed in Mandharai leaf)
profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Kanchipuram pure mulberry silk sarees with heavy zari

points: Capital of the Pallava Empire from 4th to 9th century CE
Home to Kailasanathar Temple, Ekambareswarar Temple, and Varadharaja Perumal Temple

name: Kanyakumari
summary: Southernmost tip of the Indian mainland (Cape Comorin), confluence of Arabian Sea, Indian Ocean, and Bay of Bengal.

profile.Food: Nanjil Nadu fish curry, Pazham pori, Ulundhu kali
profile.Crafts: Sea shell crafts, Banana fibre weaving

points: Features Vivekananda Rock Memorial and 133-foot stone statue of Tamil poet-philosopher Thiruvalluvar
Unique geographical site where one can witness both sunrise and sunset over the ocean

name: Karur
summary: Textile export hub on the Amaravathi and Kaveri rivers, ancient Chera inland capital vanji.

profile.Crafts: Home textiles (bed linen, towels, table mats)

points: Major global export cluster for home textiles to USA and Europe
Pasupatheeswarar Temple showcases early Chola stone architecture

name: Krishnagiri
summary: Mango capital and electronic hardware manufacturing hub bordering Karnataka, featuring historic Krishnagiri Fort.

profile.Crafts: Mango processing, Granite monuments

points: Produces over 300,000 tonnes of mangoes annually, exporting mango pulp worldwide
Hosur industrial estate hosts major electric vehicle and auto manufacturers

name: Madurai
summary: The Athens of the East and Temple City on the Vaigai river, celebrated for Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple.

profile.Food: Jigarthanda, Kari Dosa, Madurai Idli, Bun Parotta
profile.Crafts: Madurai Sungudi sarees, Jasmine (Malli) flower cultivation

points: Ancient capital of the Pandya dynasty and site of all three historic Tamil Sangams
Meenakshi Amman Temple features 14 majestic soaring gopurams with over 33,000 sculptures

name: Nagapattinam
summary: Coastal seaport district on the Bay of Bengal, spiritual center of Velankanni Basilica and Nagore Dargah.

profile.Crafts: Marine fishing, Salt manufacturing

points: Chola medieval international port linking Sri Lanka, Java, and China
Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni is called the 'Lourdes of the East'

name: Namakkal
summary: Egg City and Transport City of South India, built around the single monolithic rock fort of Namakkal Anjaneyar.

profile.Crafts: Poultry farming, Lorry body building

points: Produces over 30 million eggs daily, catering to national mid-day meal schemes
Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple features an 18-foot open-air monolithic idol of Lord Hanuman

name: The Nilgiris
summary: Blue Mountains of the Western Ghats, celebrated for Nilgiri Orthodox black tea, Ooty hill station, and Toda tribes.

profile.Food: Nilgiri tea, Homemade chocolates, Varkey pastry
profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Toda tribal geometric embroidery, Nilgiri tea processing

points: Nilgiri Mountain Railway (built 1908) is a UNESCO World Heritage rack-and-pinion steam railway
Doddabetta peak rises to 2,637 m as the highest summit in the Nilgiris

name: Ramanathapuram
summary: Island district containing sacred Rameswaram Jyotirlinga, Pamban sea bridge, and birthplace of Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam.

profile.Crafts: Chank shell carving, Palm leaf basketry

points: Ramanathaswamy Temple features the longest corridor in any Hindu temple (1,220 m) with 1,212 pillars
Pamban Bridge constructed in 1914 was India's first cantilever sea bridge

name: Salem
summary: The Steel and Mango City surrounded by hills, famed for Salem Steel Plant, Malgova mangoes, and sago production.

profile.Food: Salem Thattu Vadai Set, Malgova mango
profile.Crafts: Sago (Sabudana) processing, Silk and venpattu handlooms

points: Supplies over 70% of India's sago and tapioca starch through SAGOSERVE
Yercaud hill station sits amidst coffee and orange groves in the Shevaroy Hills

name: Thanjavur
summary: Rice Bowl of Tamil Nadu on the Kaveri delta, capital of the Chola Empire, home to Brihadisvara Temple.

profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Thanjavur gold leaf paintings, Thanjavur Bobblehead dancing dolls, Art plates

points: Brihadisvara Temple built in 1010 CE by Emperor Rajaraja Chola I, UNESCO World Heritage site
Saraswathi Mahal Library founded in the 16th century preserves rare palm-leaf manuscripts

name: Tiruchirappalli
summary: Historic delta city on the Kaveri river, renowned for the Rockfort Temple and the colossal Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple at Srirangam.

profile.Crafts: Synthetic diamond cutting, BHEL boiler manufacturing

points: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple in Srirangam is the largest functioning Hindu temple complex in the world (156 acres)
Rockfort Temple sits perched atop an ancient 3.8-billion-year-old quartz rock formation

name: Tirunelveli
summary: City of Halwa on the perennial Thamirabarani River, famed for Nellaiappar Temple and Courtallam waterfalls.

profile.Food: GI-tagged Tirunelveli wheat Halwa, Sodhi kuzhambu
profile.Crafts: Pattamadai pai (reed mats), Brass lamps

points: Nellaiappar Temple built in 7th century CE features famous musical stone pillars
Thamirabarani is the only perennial river flowing entirely within Tamil Nadu

name: Tiruvannamalai
summary: Spiritual center of Agni (Fire) element, famed for Annamalaiyar Temple, Giri Valam circumambulation, and Ramana Maharshi ashram.

profile.Food: Makkan Peda of Arani, Millet porridge
profile.Crafts: Arani silk sarees, Brass idols

points: Annamalaiyar Temple is one of the Pancha Bhoota Stalas representing the element Fire
Millions participate in monthly 14 km Giri Valam walk barefoot around Mount Arunachala

name: Vellore
summary: Fort city and medical hub on the Palar river, celebrated for Vellore Sepoy Mutiny of 1806 and CMC Hospital.

profile.Food: Ambur Dum Biryani, Vellore Boti curry
profile.Crafts: Leather tanning and footwear exports

points: Vellore Fort (built 16th century by Vijayanagara rulers) features double granite moat walls
Vellore Mutiny on 10 July 1806 was the earliest major military uprising against British rule
